entry_statement_length.name: entry_statement_length
entry_statement_length.value: "entry"."statement" IS NULL OR char_length("entry"."statement") BETWEEN 1 AND 1500

entry_submitted_at_matches_status.name: entry_submitted_at_matches_status
entry_submitted_at_matches_status.value: ("entry"."status" <> 'submitted' OR "entry"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("entry"."status" NOT IN ('processing', 'rejected', 'failed') OR "entry"."submitted_at" IS NULL)

entry_file_essay_matches_kind.name: entry_file_essay_matches_kind
entry_file_essay_matches_kind.value: ("entry_file"."kind" = 'text') = ("entry_file"."essay_body" IS NOT NULL) AND ("entry_file"."kind" = 'text') = ("entry_file"."word_count" IS NOT NULL)

entry_file_became_live_at_matches_status.name: entry_file_became_live_at_matches_status
entry_file_became_live_at_matches_status.value: ("entry_file"."status" <> 'live' OR "entry_file"."became_live_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("entry_file"."status" NOT IN ('pending', 'processing', 'rejected', 'failed') OR "entry_file"."became_live_at" IS NULL)

user_email_or_phone.name: user_email_or_phone
user_email_or_phone.value: "user"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "user"."phone_hash" IS NOT NULL

outbox_failed_at_when_failed.name: outbox_failed_at_when_failed
outbox_failed_at_when_failed.value: ("outbox"."status" = 'failed') = ("outbox"."failed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "outbox"."last_error" IS NOT NULL)

ledger_account_code_matches_kind.name: ledger_account_code_matches_kind
ledger_account_code_matches_kind.value: "ledger_account"."code" ~ '^[0-9]{4}$' AND left("ledger_account"."code", 1) = CASE "ledger_account"."kind" WHEN 'asset' THEN '1' WHEN 'liability' THEN '2' WHEN 'equity' THEN '3' WHEN 'income' THEN '4' WHEN 'expense' THEN '5' END

finance_approval_decision_matches_status.name: finance_approval_decision_matches_status
finance_approval_decision_matches_status.value:
CASE "finance_approval"."status"
        WHEN 'pending' THEN "finance_approval"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "finance_approval"."decided_by_user_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'approved' THEN "finance_approval"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "finance_approval"."decided_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "finance_approval"."decided_by_user_id" <> "finance_approval"."requested_by_user_id"
        WHEN 'rejected' THEN "finance_approval"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "finance_approval"."decided_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "finance_approval"."decided_by_user_id" <> "finance_approval"."requested_by_user_id"
        WHEN 'cancelled' THEN "finance_approval"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "finance_approval"."decided_by_user_id" = "finance_approval"."requested_by_user_id"
        WHEN 'expired' THEN "finance_approval"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "finance_approval"."decided_by_user_id" IS NULL
      END

ledger_period_locked_fields_match_status.name: ledger_period_locked_fields_match_status
ledger_period_locked_fields_match_status.value: ("ledger_period"."status" = 'locked') = ("ledger_period"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger_period"."locked_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

ledger_period_unlock_fields_together.name: ledger_period_unlock_fields_together
ledger_period_unlock_fields_together.value: ("ledger_period"."last_unlocked_at" IS NULL) = ("ledger_period"."last_unlocked_by_user_id" IS NULL) AND ("ledger_period"."last_unlocked_at" IS NULL) = ("ledger_period"."last_unlock_reason" IS NULL)

consent_event_signed_form_evidence.name: consent_event_signed_form_evidence
consent_event_signed_form_evidence.value: "consent_event"."consent_form_id" IS NULL OR ("consent_event"."method" = 'paper_form' AND "consent_event"."reviewer_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "consent_event"."giver_user_id" IS NULL)

consent_event_link_evidence.name: consent_event_link_evidence
consent_event_link_evidence.value:
("consent_event"."method" = 'otp_link') = ("consent_event"."consent_link_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("consent_event"."method" <> 'otp_link' OR (
          "consent_event"."giver_user_id" IS NULL AND "consent_event"."giver_contact_hash" IS NOT NULL
          AND "consent_event"."subject_type" = 'participant_profile'
          AND "consent_event"."competition_id" IS NOT NULL
        ))

consent_link_closed_state.name: consent_link_closed_state
consent_link_closed_state.value:
("consent_link"."status" = 'used') = ("consent_link"."used_at" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("consent_link"."status" = 'used') = ("consent_link"."answers" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("consent_link"."status" = 'revoked') = ("consent_link"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)

second_factor_totp_fields.name: second_factor_totp_fields
second_factor_totp_fields.value: "second_factor"."kind" <> 'totp' OR ("second_factor"."totp_secret_sealed" IS NOT NULL AND "second_factor"."credential_id" IS NULL AND "second_factor"."public_key" IS NULL)

second_factor_passkey_fields.name: second_factor_passkey_fields
second_factor_passkey_fields.value: "second_factor"."kind" <> 'passkey' OR ("second_factor"."credential_id" IS NOT NULL AND "second_factor"."public_key" IS NOT NULL AND "second_factor"."sign_count" IS NOT NULL AND "second_factor"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "second_factor"."totp_secret_sealed" IS NULL)

consent_form_reviewed_iff_decided.name: consent_form_reviewed_iff_decided
consent_form_reviewed_iff_decided.value:
CASE WHEN "consent_form"."status" IN ('accepted', 'rejected')
        THEN "consent_form"."reviewed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "consent_form"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL
        ELSE "consent_form"."reviewed_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "consent_form"."reviewed_at" IS NULL END

file_derivative_size_positive.name: file_derivative_size_positive
file_derivative_size_positive.value: ("file_derivative"."width" IS NULL OR "file_derivative"."width" > 0) AND ("file_derivative"."height" IS NULL OR "file_derivative"."height" > 0)

competition_published_at_matches_status.name: competition_published_at_matches_status
competition_published_at_matches_status.value: ("competition"."status" <> 'draft' OR "competition"."published_at" IS NULL) AND ("competition"."published_at" IS NOT NULL OR "competition"."status" = 'draft' OR "competition"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL)

competition_cancellation_complete.name: competition_cancellation_complete
competition_cancellation_complete.value:
("competition"."status"::text = 'cancelled') = ("competition"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("competition"."cancelled_at" IS NULL) = ("competition"."cancel_reason" IS NULL)

safeguarding_report_anonymous_has_no_rep.name: safeguarding_report_anonymous_has_no_reporter
safeguarding_report_anonymous_has_no_rep.value: NOT "safeguarding_report"."anonymous" OR ("safeguarding_report"."reporter_name_ciphertext" IS NULL AND "safeguarding_report"."reporter_contact_ciphertext" IS NULL)

safeguarding_report_resolved_has_outcome.name: safeguarding_report_resolved_has_outcome
safeguarding_report_resolved_has_outcome.value: ("safeguarding_report"."status" = 'resolved') = ("safeguarding_report"."outcome_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND "safeguarding_report"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

contact_message_closed_with_reason.name: contact_message_closed_with_reason
contact_message_closed_with_reason.value: ("contact_message"."status" = 'closed') = ("contact_message"."close_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "contact_message"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL)

institution_verified_at_matches_code.name: institution_verified_at_matches_code
institution_verified_at_matches_code.value: ("institution"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL) = ("institution"."institution_code" IS NOT NULL)

participant_profile_guardian_complete.name: participant_profile_guardian_complete
participant_profile_guardian_complete.value: ("participant_profile"."guardian_name_ciphertext" IS NULL) = ("participant_profile"."guardian_relationship" IS NULL) AND ("participant_profile"."guardian_name_ciphertext" IS NULL) = ("participant_profile"."guardian_phone_ciphertext" IS NULL)

participant_profile_pin_code_format.name: participant_profile_pin_code_format
participant_profile_pin_code_format.value: "participant_profile"."pin_code" ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{5}$' OR ("participant_profile"."country" IS NOT NULL AND "participant_profile"."country" <> 'IN' AND "participant_profile"."pin_code" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 -]{1,9}$')

payment_batch_purpose_matches_subject.name: payment_batch_purpose_matches_subject
payment_batch_purpose_matches_subject.value: ("payment_batch"."purpose" = 'registration_fee') = ("payment_batch"."competition_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_batch"."route" IS NOT NULL)

payment_batch_institution_matches_route.name: payment_batch_institution_matches_route
payment_batch_institution_matches_route.value: ("payment_batch"."route" = 'institution') = ("payment_batch"."institution_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_batch"."institution_registration_id" IS NOT NULL)

payment_batch_order_when_opened.name: payment_batch_order_when_opened
payment_batch_order_when_opened.value: "payment_batch"."gateway_order_id" IS NOT NULL OR "payment_batch"."status" NOT IN ('order_created', 'captured') OR ("payment_batch"."status" = 'captured' AND "payment_batch"."capture_method" = 'offline')

payment_batch_payment_when_captured.name: payment_batch_payment_when_captured
payment_batch_payment_when_captured.value: "payment_batch"."status" <> 'captured' OR ("payment_batch"."captured_at" IS NOT NULL AND ("payment_batch"."gateway_payment_id" IS NOT NULL OR "payment_batch"."capture_method" = 'offline'))

payment_review_case_resolved_together.name: payment_review_case_resolved_together
payment_review_case_resolved_together.value: ("payment_review_case"."resolved_at" IS NULL) = ("payment_review_case"."outcome" IS NULL) AND ("payment_review_case"."outcome" IS NULL) = ("payment_review_case"."resolution_reason" IS NULL)

payment_review_case_refund_due_matches_o.name: payment_review_case_refund_due_matches_outcome
payment_review_case_refund_due_matches_o.value: NOT "payment_review_case"."refund_due" OR ("payment_review_case"."outcome" IS NOT NULL AND ("payment_review_case"."outcome" = 'refund' OR ("payment_review_case"."outcome" = 'confirm' AND "payment_review_case"."currency" <> 'INR' AND "payment_review_case"."gateway_payment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_review_case"."amount_minor" > 0)))

payment_review_case_dashboard_refund_set.name: payment_review_case_dashboard_refund_settled
payment_review_case_dashboard_refund_set.value: "payment_review_case"."dashboard_refund_reference" IS NULL OR (NOT "payment_review_case"."refund_due" AND "payment_review_case"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_review_case"."outcome" IN ('refund', 'confirm') AND "payment_review_case"."currency" <> 'INR' AND "payment_review_case"."gateway_payment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_review_case"."amount_minor" > 0)

guardian_invitation_request_complete.name: guardian_invitation_request_complete
guardian_invitation_request_complete.value: "guardian_invitation"."kind" <> 'guardian_request' OR ("guardian_invitation"."requested_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "guardian_invitation"."invitee_name_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND "guardian_invitation"."relationship" IS NOT NULL)

guardian_invitation_request_fields_only_.name: guardian_invitation_request_fields_only_on_requests
guardian_invitation_request_fields_only_.value: "guardian_invitation"."kind" = 'guardian_request' OR ("guardian_invitation"."requested_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "guardian_invitation"."invitee_name_ciphertext" IS NULL AND "guardian_invitation"."relationship" IS NULL)

refund_decider_not_requester.name: refund_decider_not_requester
refund_decider_not_requester.value: "refund"."requested_by" IS NULL OR "refund"."decided_by" IS NULL OR "refund"."requested_by" <> "refund"."decided_by"

refund_manual_recorded_when_refunded.name: refund_manual_recorded_when_refunded
refund_manual_recorded_when_refunded.value: "refund"."method" <> 'manual' OR "refund"."status" <> 'refunded' OR ("refund"."manual_method" IS NOT NULL AND "refund"."manual_reference" IS NOT NULL)

breach_record_notified_has_a_notice.name: breach_record_notified_has_a_notice
breach_record_notified_has_a_notice.value: "breach_record"."status" <> 'notified' OR "breach_record"."principals_notified_at" IS NOT NULL OR "breach_record"."authority_notified_at" IS NOT NULL

breach_record_reference_after_notice.name: breach_record_reference_after_notice
breach_record_reference_after_notice.value: "breach_record"."authority_reference_ciphertext" IS NULL OR "breach_record"."authority_notified_at" IS NOT NULL

announcement_sent_stamped.name: announcement_sent_stamped
announcement_sent_stamped.value: ("announcement"."status" = 'sent') = ("announcement"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("announcement"."sent_at" IS NULL) = ("announcement"."recipient_count" IS NULL)

legal_hold_released_by_only_when_release.name: legal_hold_released_by_only_when_released
legal_hold_released_by_only_when_release.value: "legal_hold"."released_by_user_id" IS NULL OR "legal_hold"."released_at" IS NOT NULL

donation_offline_details.name: donation_offline_details
donation_offline_details.value: ("donation"."origin" = 'offline_entry' AND "donation"."offline_method" IS NOT NULL AND "donation"."offline_reference" IS NOT NULL AND "donation"."offline_received_on" IS NOT NULL AND "donation"."offline_proof_file_id" IS NOT NULL AND "donation"."payment_batch_id" IS NULL) OR ("donation"."origin" <> 'offline_entry' AND "donation"."offline_method" IS NULL AND "donation"."offline_reference" IS NULL AND "donation"."offline_received_on" IS NULL AND "donation"."offline_proof_file_id" IS NULL AND "donation"."offline_recorded_by" IS NULL)

donation_online_has_batch.name: donation_online_has_batch
donation_online_has_batch.value: "donation"."origin" <> 'online_checkout' OR ("donation"."payment_batch_id" IS NOT NULL AND "donation"."checkout_token_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "donation"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

donation_captured_at_when_kept.name: donation_captured_at_when_kept
donation_captured_at_when_kept.value: "donation"."status" NOT IN ('captured', 'partially_refunded') OR "donation"."captured_at" IS NOT NULL

privacy_request_export_ready.name: privacy_request_export_ready
privacy_request_export_ready.value: ("privacy_request"."export_ready_at" IS NULL) = ("privacy_request"."export_storage_key" IS NULL) AND ("privacy_request"."export_ready_at" IS NULL) = ("privacy_request"."export_expires_at" IS NULL)

privacy_request_erasure_approval.name: privacy_request_erasure_approval
privacy_request_erasure_approval.value: ("privacy_request"."erasure_fingerprint" IS NULL OR "privacy_request"."type" = 'erasure') AND ("privacy_request"."erasure_fingerprint" IS NULL) = ("privacy_request"."erasure_approved_at" IS NULL)

directory_listing_verified_at_matches_st.name: directory_listing_verified_at_matches_status
directory_listing_verified_at_matches_st.value: "directory_listing"."status" NOT IN ('verified', 'suspended') OR "directory_listing"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL

adoption_listing_published_at_matches_st.name: adoption_listing_published_at_matches_status
adoption_listing_published_at_matches_st.value: "adoption_listing"."status" NOT IN ('published', 'on_hold', 'adopted') OR "adoption_listing"."published_at" IS NOT NULL

adoption_application_contact_shared.name: adoption_application_contact_shared
adoption_application_contact_shared.value: "adoption_application"."status" NOT IN ('in_contact', 'adopted') OR "adoption_application"."contact_shared_at" IS NOT NULL

campaign_sent_stamped.name: campaign_sent_stamped
campaign_sent_stamped.value: ("campaign"."status" = 'draft') = ("campaign"."sent_at" IS NULL) AND ("campaign"."sent_at" IS NULL) = ("campaign"."planned_counts" IS NULL)

volunteer_application_approval_recorded.name: volunteer_application_approval_recorded
volunteer_application_approval_recorded.value: "volunteer_application"."status" <> 'approved' OR ("volunteer_application"."safeguarding_consent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "volunteer_application"."conduct_consent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "volunteer_application"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

volunteer_application_decline_has_reason.name: volunteer_application_decline_has_reason
volunteer_application_decline_has_reason.value: "volunteer_application"."status" <> 'declined' OR ("volunteer_application"."decline_reason_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND "volunteer_application"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

entry_verification_resubmission_complete.name: entry_verification_resubmission_complete
entry_verification_resubmission_complete.value: ("entry_verification"."resubmitted_at" IS NULL) = ("entry_verification"."resubmission_with_file" IS NULL) AND ("entry_verification"."resubmitted_at" IS NULL OR "entry_verification"."decision" = 'sent_back')

judging_round_source.name: judging_round_source
judging_round_source.value: ("judging_round"."entry_source" = 'round_finalists') = ("judging_round"."source_round_id" IS NOT NULL) AND "judging_round"."source_round_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "judging_round"."id"

judging_round_cancel_reason.name: judging_round_cancel_reason
judging_round_cancel_reason.value: ("judging_round"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("judging_round"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "judging_round"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL)

judging_round_lock_metadata.name: judging_round_lock_metadata
judging_round_lock_metadata.value: ("judging_round"."status" = 'locked') = ("judging_round"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "judging_round"."tie_break_rule" IS NOT NULL) AND ("judging_round"."lock_override_reason" IS NULL OR "judging_round"."status" = 'locked')

judge_conflict_target.name: judge_conflict_target
judge_conflict_target.value: ("judge_conflict"."source" = 'declared' AND "judge_conflict"."institution_id" IS NOT NULL AND "judge_conflict"."entry_id" IS NULL) OR ("judge_conflict"."source" = 'staff' AND "judge_conflict"."institution_id" IS NULL AND "judge_conflict"."entry_id" IS NOT NULL)

physical_artwork_dispatch_recorded_toget.name: physical_artwork_dispatch_recorded_together
physical_artwork_dispatch_recorded_toget.value: ("physical_artwork"."courier_name" IS NULL) = ("physical_artwork"."dispatched_at" IS NULL) AND ("physical_artwork"."tracking_number" IS NULL) = ("physical_artwork"."dispatched_at" IS NULL)

artwork_verification_dimensions.name: artwork_verification_dimensions
artwork_verification_dimensions.value: "artwork_verification"."width_mm" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 AND "artwork_verification"."height_mm" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 AND ("artwork_verification"."depth_mm" IS NULL OR "artwork_verification"."depth_mm" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000)

round_result_award_position.name: round_result_award_position
round_result_award_position.value: CASE "round_result"."outcome" WHEN 'winner' THEN "round_result"."award_position" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 1 WHEN 'runner_up' THEN "round_result"."award_position" IS NOT NULL AND "round_result"."award_position" BETWEEN 2 AND 3 ELSE "round_result"."award_position" IS NULL END
